name: nopCommerce
title: nopCommerce SvelteKit Storefront — Svelte Commerce Connector
description: Svelte Commerce on nopCommerce via the Web API Frontend plugin: 24 of 43 services wired, but the storefront cannot place an order yet. Setup and limits.
lede: nopCommerce core ships no REST API, so this connector targets the Web API Frontend plugin’s contract, v4.50.09 from 2022. Browsing, cart and sign-in are wired; the storefront cannot place an order on it yet.
verdict: Browsing, cart and sign-in are wired, but the storefront cannot complete an order yet. nopCommerce checks out in five steps through its plugin, with payment chosen by a payment plugin’s system name. The connector wires those steps as nopCommerce-native methods, but the storefront’s payment step calls one method per gateway, and each of those throws `NotSupportedError`.

quickStart.text: one connector at a time: remove the two the storefront ships with, add this one
point it at your nopCommerce store

env.name: PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_API_URL
env.note: Base URL of the nopCommerce store running the Web API Frontend plugin. Boot fails, naming this variable, if it is missing.

env.name: PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.note: A customer token to start from. Without one, the connector requests a guest token before the first cart or wishlist call.

env.name: PUBLIC_CONNECTOR
env.note: Only when more than one connector is installed: `@misiki/nopcommerce-connector` names the one this build runs on.

envNote: `init.ts` hands the connector every `PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_*` variable that is set, camel-cased. The guide also lists `PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_API_KEY`, `PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_API_SECRET`, `PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_ACCESS_KEY`, `PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_STORE_ID` and `PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_CHANNEL_ID`; the connector’s source does not read them.
backendSettings: Install nopCommerce’s Web API Framework and Web API Frontend plugins. Core ships no REST API; the connector targets the Frontend plugin’s v4.50.09 contract.
howItWorks: The connector speaks the Web API Frontend plugin’s contract (v4.50.09, 2022), not nopCommerce core, which has no REST API. A shopper who has not signed in gets a guest token before the first cart call, and tokens travel as `Authorization: Bearer`.

Checkout in nopCommerce is five steps — billing address, shipping method, payment method, payment info, confirm — with the payment chosen by a payment plugin’s system name, and redirect gateways finishing on the store’s own return URL. The connector wires those steps as nopCommerce-native methods; the storefront’s per-gateway methods throw `NotSupportedError`, because an empty answer from a checkout call reads as “payment started”.
limitations: The storefront cannot place an order. The storefront’s payment step calls one method per gateway — cash on delivery, Razorpay, Stripe and the rest — and nopCommerce has no per-gateway route, so each throws `NotSupportedError`. The connector’s nopCommerce-native checkout steps are not called by the storefront yet.

troubleshooting.fix: The connector sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, as the plugin’s security scheme describes; the plugin’s own curl example sends the bare token. If your store expects the bare token, set `BaseService.AUTH_RAW_TOKEN = true` once at startup.

faq.q: Can I run a nopCommerce store on Svelte Commerce today?
faq.a: Not to take orders. Browsing, cart and sign-in are wired through the Web API Frontend plugin, but the storefront’s payment step calls per-gateway methods that throw on nopCommerce. The connector wires nopCommerce’s own five-step checkout; the storefront does not call it yet.

faq.q: How do I switch Svelte Commerce to nopCommerce?
faq.a: Remove the connectors the storefront ships with, install `@misiki/nopcommerce-connector`, set `PUBLIC_NOPCOMMERCE_API_URL` in `.env` and start the dev server. `vite.config.ts` resolves whichever connector is installed, so no file in the storefront changes.

faq.q: Does nopCommerce need a plugin for Svelte Commerce?
faq.a: Yes. nopCommerce core ships no REST API, so the connector targets the Web API Frontend plugin’s contract, version 4.50.09 from 2022, which needs the Web API Framework plugin too. If a newer contract is published, the Svelte Commerce maintainers have asked to be pointed at it.

openQuestion: If there is a published API contract newer than Web API Frontend v4.50.09, where is it?

api.surface: The connector calls the paid Web API Frontend plugin under `/api-frontend`, an RPC-style JSON API shaped `/api-frontend/{Controller}/{Action}[/{id}]` and pinned to the plugin’s published OpenAPI contract v4.50.09.
api.auth: `POST /api-frontend/Authenticate/GetToken` returns a JWT that the connector holds in its credentials and sends as `Authorization: Bearer`; with no token it first requests one with `is_guest: true`, because the token is the whole session and nopCommerce has no cart ID or cart cookie.

calls.what: `GET /api-frontend/UrlRecord/GetBySlug?slug=` to turn a slug into an ID, then `GET /api-frontend/Product/GetProductDetails/{id}`; lists use `POST /api-frontend/Catalog/GetCategoryProducts/{id}` with `page_number`, `page_size` and `order_by` in the body
`GET /api-frontend/Catalog/GetCatalogRoot?loadImage=true` for the tree and `POST /api-frontend/Catalog/GetCategory/{id}` for one category
`POST /api-frontend/Catalog/Search?q=` with a paging command, and `GET /api-frontend/Catalog/SearchTermAutoComplete?term=` for suggestions

`GET /api-frontend/ShoppingCart/Cart`, `POST /api-frontend/ShoppingCart/AddProductToCartFromCatalog/{id}?shoppingCartType=ShoppingCart&quantity=` and `POST /api-frontend/ShoppingCart/UpdateCart` for quantity changes and removals
`GET /api-frontend/Order/CustomerOrders` and `GET /api-frontend/Order/Details/{id}`, both scoped to the token’s customer

rules: Detail routes take an integer ID, never a slug, so every slug costs a `UrlRecord/GetBySlug` lookup first; the connector caches the answers, misses included.

Catalogue lists are `POST` requests with the paging in the JSON body, and the real totals are read from a nested pager block such as `catalog_products_model`; routes that return a bare array are reported as one page of what came back.

Cart changes are sent as storefront form fields, such as `itemquantity{cartItemId}` and `removefromcart`, because the cart controller has no `DELETE` and removal goes through `ShoppingCart/UpdateCart`.
A price filter is one `price` string in the form `from-to`, and sorting is a numeric `order_by` in which creation date sorts newest first only.
On a 401 the connector replaces only a guest token, never a signed-in customer’s, and a failed sign-in is not retried with the username, since each attempt counts towards the store’s lockout limit.
